sn56.37:1.1: suriyassa bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ yadidaṃ aruṇaggaṃ.
sn56.37:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamayāya etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ yadidaṃ sammādiṭṭhi.
sn56.37:1.4: “idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānissati …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānissati”.
sn56.37:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
